title: "performance_analysis_5_on_5"

# Setup 
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)

final <- fread("nhl_2025_26_player_shift_data.csv")
```

# 2. Exact 5v5 observations only

```{r}
player_5v5 <- final[
  is_5v5 == 1L &
    !is.na(player_id) &
    !is.na(shift_age_mid_sec)
]
```


# Remove accidental duplicate player rows

```{r}
player_5v5 <- unique(
  player_5v5,
  by = c(
    "game_id",
    "team",
    "period",
    "interval_start",
    "player_id"
  )
)
```



# 3. Collapse player rows to ONE team row per 5-second interval

```{r}
safe_mean <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0L || all(is.na(x))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}


team_5v5 <- player_5v5[
  ,
  .(
    opp_team = first(opp_team),
    score_diff = first(score_diff),

    n_skaters = uniqueN(player_id),

    n_forwards = uniqueN(
      player_id[fwd_def == "Forward"]
    ),

    n_defense = uniqueN(
      player_id[fwd_def == "Defense"]
    ),

    # Average fatigue of the five skaters
    mean_shift_age_sec = safe_mean(
      shift_age_mid_sec
    ),

    # Team xG appears only once in this collapsed row
    xGF_5v5 = first(xGF_5v5),
    xGA_5v5 = first(xGA_5v5)
  ),
  by = .(
    game_id,
    team,
    period,
    interval_start
  )
]


```


# Keep properly reconstructed 3F / 2D units

```{r}
team_5v5 <- team_5v5[
  n_skaters == 5L &
    n_forwards == 3L &
    n_defense == 2L
]
```



# 4. Create 5-second fatigue bins

```{r}
BIN_SECONDS <- 5L

team_5v5[
  ,
  fatigue_sec := mean_shift_age_sec
]

team_5v5[
  ,
  fatigue_bin :=
    BIN_SECONDS * floor(fatigue_sec / BIN_SECONDS)
]

```




# GRAPH 1:
# Average xGF vs xGA by team fatigue

```{r}
xg_by_fatigue <- team_5v5[
  fatigue_bin <= 75,
  .(
    mean_xGF = mean(
      xGF_5v5,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    mean_xGA = mean(
      xGA_5v5,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    n_intervals = .N,

    n_games = uniqueN(game_id)
  ),
  by = fatigue_bin
]

setorder(
  xg_by_fatigue,
  fatigue_bin
)


combined <- melt(
  xg_by_fatigue,

  id.vars = c(
    "fatigue_bin",
    "n_intervals",
    "n_games"
  ),

  measure.vars = c(
    "mean_xGF",
    "mean_xGA"
  ),

  variable.name = "metric",
  value.name = "value"
)


combined[
  ,
  metric := fcase(
    metric == "mean_xGF", "xGF",
    metric == "mean_xGA", "xGA"
  )
]


ggplot(
  combined,
  aes(
    x = fatigue_bin,
    y = value,
    color = metric
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "xGF" = "steelblue",
      "xGA" = "firebrick"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Average 5v5 xGF vs xGA by Unit Fatigue",
    subtitle = "Fatigue measured as average shift age of all five skaters",
    x = "Average seconds into shift",
    y = "Average xG per 5-second interval",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw()


```



# GRAPH 2:
# xG margin with 95% confidence interval
#
# IMPORTANT:
# Calculate uncertainty across GAMES rather than treating every
# 5-second interval as an independent observation.

```{r}
game_margin_by_fatigue <- team_5v5[
  fatigue_bin <= 75,
  .(
    game_mean_margin = mean(
      xGF_5v5 - xGA_5v5,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ),
  by = .(
    game_id,
    fatigue_bin
  )
]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# xG margin by unit fatigue
# Each TEAM x 5-second interval is one observation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

margin_by_fatigue <- team_5v5[
  fatigue_bin <= 75,
  .(
    mean_margin = mean(
      xGF_5v5 - xGA_5v5,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    sd_margin = sd(
      xGF_5v5 - xGA_5v5,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    n_intervals = .N,

    n_games = uniqueN(game_id)
  ),
  by = fatigue_bin
]


# Standard error based on team-interval observations
margin_by_fatigue[
  ,
  se := sd_margin / sqrt(n_intervals)
]


# 95% confidence interval
margin_by_fatigue[
  ,
  `:=`(
    ymin = mean_margin - 1.96 * se,
    ymax = mean_margin + 1.96 * se
  )
]


setorder(
  margin_by_fatigue,
  fatigue_bin
)


ggplot(
  margin_by_fatigue,
  aes(
    x = fatigue_bin,
    y = mean_margin
  )
) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax
    ),
    fill = "darkgreen",
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_line(
    color = "darkgreen",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.5,
    color = "darkgreen"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "5v5 xG Margin by Unit Fatigue",
    subtitle = "Each team 5-second interval treated as one observation",
    x = "Average seconds into shift",
    y = "xGF - xGA per 5-second interval (+/- 95% CI)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

# linear model (simple)
```{r}
# Outcome
team_5v5[, xg_margin := xGF_5v5 - xGA_5v5]

# Focus on the range where there is reasonable support
model_data <- team_5v5[
  fatigue_sec <= 70 &
    !is.na(xg_margin) &
    !is.na(fatigue_sec)
]

# Basic linear model
m1 <- lm(
  xg_margin ~ fatigue_sec,
  data = model_data
)

summary(m1)
```
#game clustered SE
```{r}

coeftest(
  m1,
  vcov = vcovCL(
    m1,
    cluster = ~ game_id
  )
)

coef(m1)["(Intercept)"]
coef(m1)["fatigue_sec"] * 30

(0.0006649977-0.0006768773)/0.0006649977
```
```{r}
team_5v5[
  ,
  shift_length_group := cut(
    fatigue_sec,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 30, 45, 60, Inf),
    labels = c(
      "0-30",
      "30-45",
      "45-60",
      "60+"
    ),
    right = FALSE
  )
]

shift_effect <- team_5v5[
  ,
  .(
    xGF = mean(xGF_5v5, na.rm = TRUE),
    xGA = mean(xGA_5v5, na.rm = TRUE),
    xG_margin = mean(xGF_5v5 - xGA_5v5, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_intervals = .N,
    n_games = uniqueN(game_id)
  ),
  by = shift_length_group
]

shift_effect

1 - (0.001447454/0.002276978)
0.002553772/0.002023231
```
#During the first 30 seconds of a shift, teams had an average 5v5 xG differential of +0.000254 per 5-second interval. Once the average unit shift age reached 60 seconds or more, the differential fell to −0.001106. Compared with the first 30 seconds, xGF decreased by approximately 36.4% while xGA increased by approximately 26.2%.


#compared to powerplay
```{r}
strength_xga <- final[
  strength %in% c("EV", "PK"),
  .(
    xGA = mean(xGA, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = .N
  ),
  by = strength
]

strength_xga

strength_xga_team <- final[
  strength %in% c("EV", "PK"),
  .(
    strength = first(strength),
    xGA = first(xGA)
  ),
  by = .(
    game_id,
    team,
    period,
    interval_start
  )
]

strength_xga_summary <- strength_xga_team[
  ,
  .(
    mean_xGA = mean(xGA, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_intervals = .N,
    n_games = uniqueN(game_id)
  ),
  by = strength
]

strength_xga_summary

xga_5v5 <- strength_xga_summary[strength == "EV", mean_xGA]
xga_pk  <- strength_xga_summary[strength == "PK", mean_xGA]

pk_xga_increase_pct <- 100 * (xga_pk - xga_5v5) / xga_5v5

pk_xga_increase_pct

26.2/61.94
```
When a team takes a penalty and goes on the penalty kill they see around a 61.94% increase in xGA compared to even strength. The increase on 5 on 5 from a under 30 second shift to an over 60 second shift was 26.2%. 

Meaning the deterioration in 5v5 xG margin from the first 30 seconds of a shift to 60+ seconds is roughly 42.30% as large as the average xGA increase created by going a man down.

#No Stoppage
```{r}
xgf_no_stoppage <- final[strength == "EV" & has_stoppage == FALSE,
                          .(mean_xGF = mean(xGF), n = .N),
                          by = time_in_shift]
setorder(xgf_no_stoppage, time_in_shift)

xga_no_stoppage <- final[strength == "EV" & has_stoppage == FALSE,
                          .(mean_xGA = mean(xGA), n = .N),
                          by = time_in_shift]
setorder(xga_no_stoppage, time_in_shift)

combined_no_stoppage <- rbind(
  xgf_no_stoppage[, .(time_in_shift, value = mean_xGF, metric = "xGF")],
  xga_no_stoppage[, .(time_in_shift, value = mean_xGA, metric = "xGA")]
)

ggplot(combined_no_stoppage[time_in_shift <= 90],
       aes(x = time_in_shift, y = value, color = metric)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("xGF" = "steelblue", "xGA" = "firebrick")) +
  labs(
    title = "Average xGF vs xGA by Time on Ice — Continuous Shifts Only (5-on-5)",
    x = "Seconds into current shift",
    y = "Average value per 5-second interval",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw()

xg_margin_no_stoppage <- final[strength == "EV" & has_stoppage == FALSE, .(
  mean_margin = mean(xGF - xGA),
  sd_margin = sd(xGF - xGA),
  n = .N
), by = time_in_shift]

xg_margin_no_stoppage[, se := sd_margin / sqrt(n)]
xg_margin_no_stoppage[, ymin := mean_margin - 1.96 * se]
xg_margin_no_stoppage[, ymax := mean_margin + 1.96 * se]

setorder(xg_margin_no_stoppage, time_in_shift)

ggplot(xg_margin_no_stoppage[time_in_shift <= 90],
       aes(x = time_in_shift, y = mean_margin)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax), fill = "darkorange", alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(color = "darkorange", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, color = "darkorange") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  labs(
    title = "xG Margin by Time on Ice — Continuous Shifts Only (5-on-5)",
    x = "Seconds into current shift",
    y = "xGF − xGA per 5-second interval (± 95% CI)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

CHAT:
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

final <- fread("nhl_2025_26_player_shift_data.csv")
setDT(final)

required_columns <- c(
  "game_id", "team", "opp_team", "period", "interval_start",
  "player_id", "fwd_def", "is_5v5", "shift_age_mid_sec",
  "xGF_5v5", "xGA_5v5", "score_diff"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(final))

if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns: ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Exact 5-on-5 player observations only.
player_5v5 <- final[
  is_5v5 == 1L &
    !is.na(player_id) &
    !is.na(shift_age_mid_sec)
]

# Defensive check against accidental duplicate player rows.
player_5v5 <- unique(
  player_5v5,
  by = c(
    "game_id", "team", "period",
    "interval_start", "player_id"
  )
)

# Team xG should be identical across all five player rows belonging
# to the same team and five-second interval.
xg_check <- player_5v5[
  ,
  .(
    n_xgf_values = uniqueN(xGF_5v5),
    n_xga_values = uniqueN(xGA_5v5)
  ),
  by = .(game_id, team, period, interval_start)
]

if (xg_check[n_xgf_values > 1L | n_xga_values > 1L, .N] > 0L) {
  stop("Some team intervals contain conflicting xG values.")
}

safe_mean <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0L || all(is.na(x))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

safe_max <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0L || all(is.na(x))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Collapse the five player rows into one team-interval row.
team_5v5 <- player_5v5[
  ,
  .(
    opp_team = first(opp_team),
    score_diff = first(score_diff),

    n_skaters = uniqueN(player_id),
    n_forwards = uniqueN(
      player_id[fwd_def == "Forward"],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_defense = uniqueN(
      player_id[fwd_def == "Defense"],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    # Fatigue measures at the interval midpoint.
    mean_shift_age_sec = safe_mean(shift_age_mid_sec),
    median_shift_age_sec = median(
      shift_age_mid_sec,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    max_shift_age_sec = safe_max(shift_age_mid_sec),

    mean_forward_shift_age_sec = safe_mean(
      shift_age_mid_sec[fwd_def == "Forward"]
    ),

    mean_defense_shift_age_sec = safe_mean(
      shift_age_mid_sec[fwd_def == "Defense"]
    ),

    # Keep the team outcome only once.
    xGF_5v5 = first(xGF_5v5),
    xGA_5v5 = first(xGA_5v5)
  ),
  by = .(game_id, team, period, interval_start)
]

# Restrict to correctly reconstructed standard 3-forward/2-defense units.
team_5v5 <- team_5v5[
  n_skaters == 5L &
    n_forwards == 3L &
    n_defense == 2L
]

# Save the separate derived table.
fwrite(
  team_5v5,
  "nhl_2025_26_team_interval_5v5.csv"
)

cat("Valid 5v5 team intervals:", nrow(team_5v5), "\n")
```

```{r}
team_5v5[
  ,
  fatigue_sec := mean_shift_age_sec
]

team_5v5[
  ,
  fatigue_bin := BIN_SECONDS * floor(fatigue_sec / BIN_SECONDS)
]

xg_by_fatigue <- team_5v5[
  fatigue_bin <= 90,
  .(
    mean_xGF = mean(xGF_5v5, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_xGA = mean(xGA_5v5, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_margin = mean(xGF_5v5 - xGA_5v5, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_intervals = .N,
    n_games = uniqueN(game_id)
  ),
  by = fatigue_bin
]

setorder(xg_by_fatigue, fatigue_bin)

combined <- melt(
  xg_by_fatigue,
  id.vars = c("fatigue_bin", "n_intervals", "n_games"),
  measure.vars = c("mean_xGF", "mean_xGA"),
  variable.name = "metric",
  value.name = "value"
)

combined[
  ,
  metric := fcase(
    metric == "mean_xGF", "xGF",
    metric == "mean_xGA", "xGA"
  )
]

ggplot(
  combined,
  aes(
    x = fatigue_bin,
    y = value,
    color = metric
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "xGF" = "steelblue",
      "xGA" = "firebrick"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Average 5v5 xGF and xGA by Unit Fatigue",
    subtitle = "Fatigue measured as the average shift age of all five skaters",
    x = "Average seconds on ice",
    y = "Average xG per 5-second interval",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```
Margin CI
```{r}
game_margin_by_fatigue <- team_5v5[
  fatigue_bin <= 90,
  .(
    game_mean_margin = mean(
      xGF_5v5 - xGA_5v5,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ),
  by = .(game_id, fatigue_bin)
]

margin_by_fatigue <- game_margin_by_fatigue[
  ,
  .(
    mean_margin = mean(game_mean_margin, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_margin = sd(game_mean_margin, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_games = .N
  ),
  by = fatigue_bin
]

margin_by_fatigue <- margin_by_fatigue[n_games >= 2L]

margin_by_fatigue[
  ,
  se := sd_margin / sqrt(n_games)
]

margin_by_fatigue[
  ,
  `:=`(
    ymin = mean_margin - 1.96 * se,
    ymax = mean_margin + 1.96 * se
  )
]

setorder(margin_by_fatigue, fatigue_bin)

ggplot(
  margin_by_fatigue,
  aes(
    x = fatigue_bin,
    y = mean_margin
  )
) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    fill = "darkgreen",
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_line(
    color = "darkgreen",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.5,
    color = "darkgreen"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "5v5 xG Margin by Unit Fatigue",
    subtitle = "Intervals collapsed to team level; uncertainty calculated across games",
    x = "Average seconds on ice",
    y = "Average xGF - xGA per 5-second interval"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```
